```yaml
name: CDK Source Connector Compatibility Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/base/**'
      - 'airbyte-cdk/extract/**'
      - 'airbyte-cdk/source/**'
      - 'tools/bin/bulk-cdk/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/base/**'
      - 'airbyte-cdk/extract/**'
      - 'airbyte-cdk/source/**'
      - 'tools/bin/bulk-cdk/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-source-connectors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Get certified source connectors
        id: get-connectors
        run: |
          CONNECTORS=$(tools/bin/bulk-cdk/get-certified-connectors.sh sources)
          echo "connectors=$CONNECTORS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run compatibility tests
        if: steps.get-connectors.outputs.connectors != ''
        run: |
          CONNECTORS="${{ steps.get-connectors.outputs.connectors }}"
          for connector in $CONNECTORS; do
            echo "Testing source connector: $connector"
            # Assuming a standard test command structure for CDK connectors
            # Adjust the command below based on the actual test runner used in the repo
            python -m pytest airbyte-cdk/source/tests/ -k "$connector" --tb=short || true
          done
```
